opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK institutions of higher education, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations defined as eligible by UKRI. Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. Assessed via a two-stage process (Outline and Detailed Applications); the Detailed Application round is open with a deadline of 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who will coordinate the visit; some specialist arts institutions are permitted to apply.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research within the UK.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities defined as an institution registered by the Office for Students and holding its own research degree awarding powers. Previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) are eligible in this round.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: The awards will be for up to £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at lecturer level or equivalent with at least two years' post-PhD experience, holding a permanent UK academic appointment or nominated by a UK university; must have right to work in the UK.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: All research areas except medical/clinical and certain excluded areas

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration, resident in the UK, permanent members of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research. Applications materials will be available on the page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, living in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks a year, with an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Application materials will be available on the page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research
